scope: Independent artifact integrity audit during final blind review. No final reviewer files or semantic scores were opened or computed; no findings were sent to reviewers.

prompt_construction.current: Exact equality to current build_final_prompt with grounded_v2 domain, case profile and language=en.
prompt_construction.candidate: Exact equality to current prompt + two newlines + the frozen supplement.
prompt_construction.manual: Exact equality to prior pilot manual prompt indexed by the complete profile.

verification.final_reviews: Not read or hashed. Final review seals are outside this during-review generation audit; selection review files were byte-hashed solely to verify their pre-existing seal.

provenance.generation_method: Protocol describes fresh Codex agents using inherited model/settings and first outputs saved. This artifact audit verifies saved content and mappings, not hidden runtime execution.
provenance.model_identifier_status: Exact runtime model identity is not exposed in the inspected generation artifacts.
provenance.decoding_settings_status: Temperature, seed and other runtime decoding settings were not exposed in inspected artifacts.
provenance.generator_agent_ids_status: Not recorded in the inspected input/output files; orchestration logs remain separate evidence.
provenance.api_execution: No model/API executor was called. Only local prompt builders, file hashing and deterministic checks were used.
provenance.first_output_caveat: Creation and last-write times describe persisted output files. They do not establish first response generation, absence of discarded responses, model execution latency, or end-to-end user waiting time.
provenance.word_count_definition: Python whitespace splitting via len(text.split()); these are words by that definition, not tokenizer tokens.
provenance.tests: Not rerun; root reported 98 relevant passing tests (11 new and 87 existing), which this audit did not independently re-execute.

limitations: Hash manifests establish agreement with recorded hashes; they are not trusted external timestamps or cryptographic proof of historical execution order.
Exact-source disjointness does not establish document-family independence, novelty against model pretraining, or absence of near duplicates.
Automatic checks are limited format heuristics and lexical diagnostics, not semantic preservation, factual correctness, human preference or adoption judgments.
Repeated identical summaries are reported as saved text agreement, not evidence of independent stochastic replication.
No token usage, monetary performance, wall-clock generation latency or semantic scores are estimated.
Annotation audit and source-only findings remain separately recorded; this audit does not revise anchors, rubric, candidate, generated outputs or reviews.
